method: Private painted breadcrumb hit and toolkit popup/key handlers with framebuffer captures; no native input
checks: deep path retains every ancestor including above HOME, with bounded painted hit rectangles
Escape returns focus to the browser and preserves the current path, generation and selection
Alt+Down opens the ancestor menu without pointer input and Escape restores the same browser context
toolkit keyboard navigation picks the exact last hidden ancestor above the background submenu
hidden-ancestor submenu opens the exact path in a background tab while preserving browser context
middle-click on a visible ancestor opens a background tab without changing the active path
middle-click on the overflow control never runs its primary popup/navigation action
